# OpenPGP security actions dismiss their popup without clearing the key source they use

The patch dismisses the owning security popup before button actions and removes popup-local key copies that popuphidden cleared. The key handlers read current Enigmail.hdrView IDs after hiding; signature key details can request a message reload through the returned refresh flag. Valid header IDs remain a caller requirement because openKeyDetails uses keyId.replace. This is not general null-safe key opening or proof of crypto success. Popup presentation reset, header state lifetime and dialog result are separate. Static wiring only; no key dialog, reload, focus or accessibility test ran.

Scope: Message security popup and OpenPGP key detail state.
